description: A `$defs` chain of 1000 single-hop `$ref`s (`L0 -> L1 -> ... -> L1000 = {type: object}`), reply `{}`: the documented accepted boundary both engines agree on (Python's own `RecursionError` starts somewhere between 1000 and 2000 hops; electricity's own cap -- `electricity_schema::engine::MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH` -- is well above 1000).
